weak_spot_explanations.Western_Ghats: Higher precipitation error (MAE ~12-18mm) due to steep orographic gradients and complex coastal topography.
weak_spot_explanations.Northeast_India: Moderate temperature error due to dense forest cover, elevation variation, and transboundary monsoon surges.
weak_spot_explanations.Himalayas_North: Elevated temperature error in high-altitude cells (>2000m) driven by localized snow-albedo dynamics.
